title: Kepler to Müller, 26 August 1630
author: Johannes Kepler
source: Johannes Kepler's letter to Philipp Müller written at Sagan on 26 August 1630, sending the last years of his *Ephemerides* (to 1636) in casks to Leipzig, with instructions for their sale at the Frankfurt fair. The original is in the Bibliothèque nationale, Paris (Nouv. acq. lat. 1635, fols. 100–101; 89, 8. H. 21), with a copy in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire. First printed in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 76–77.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Kepler sends the remaining years of the *Ephemerides*, to 1636, in two casks, with instructions for storing them at Frankfurt and for the entry in the fair catalogue.

notes.note: “One volume of the *Ephemerides* of Jo. Kepler (Imperial Mathematician) for twenty years, from 1617 to 1636. Completed at Sagan in Silesia, 1630.”
